thread:
benji: Heads-up  joint vendor roadmap sync TOMORROW 8:30am PT. Objective: converge on GA-ish windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300 shipping lanes, Gaudi revB stability, and the announcement/marketplace gating plan.

tara: Can we surface two new constraints: customs/regional holdups in APAC that might push MI300 stock later, and any vendors needing air-gapped packaging for on-prem customers?

press_ops: Please confirm embargo preferences from partners. Last cycle NVIDIA asked for ~9 days, AMD asked ~6. We need explicit numbers to plan press briefings.

vendor_reminder_bot: Reminder: fill vendor preflight by EOD: https://forms.redwood.example/preflight-2025-hw. Auto-remind in 10h.

eli-infra: Capacity note: optimistic H100 Dedicated GA target 2025-06-10, fallback capacity planning for H200 family in case H100 shipping slips. We can keep "golden canary" cohort at small scale to validate KV-cache and batching perf. We recommend 45d telemetry retention for the canary cohort to catch slow regressions.

si_kevin: SI asks: full canary image bundles (aws/azure/gcp), driver bundles, and a signed changelog for microcode. Also need integration windows so we can schedule SI runbooks.

aris-partners: From partners: Habana engineering flags a revB kernel race on streaming; patch ETA May 18. If slip > 72h, partners prefer Gaudi be delayed to last announce wave.

benji: Proposal (timeline idea): Wave 1: H100 -> early Dedicated + invite-only Hosted; Wave 2: MI300 + H200 -> wider Hosted + Dedicated; Wave 3: Gaudi + B200 -> economy lane. Waves spaced ~2 weeks but flexible if embargos force longer.

tara: Ops addition: fallback mapping rule - if a SKU misses Wave 1, route traffic to a software-compatible family and label UI as "compat: family-name". Also, require vendor-provided SLO matrix (latency/cost/throughput) so we can publish guidance.

benji: Example fallback snippet to share with vendors: 
```
fallback_map:
  - from: H100-v1
    to_family: H200-family
    announce_label: "H100-compatible"
    reason: "supply"
```

press_ops: Legal note  firmware/microcode is sometimes embargoed separately. If vendors treat microcode as embargoed, add an extra buffer in the comms plan.

eli-infra: Regarding MI300: shipping lanes to eu-west may add 10-14 days due to customs. We'll mark MI300 regional flags in the SKU matrix.

si_kevin: Can we get quantization artifacts (scripts or artifacts) from vendors? Even an export script reduces SI onboarding by weeks.

aris-partners: Vendors also asked about on-prem HSM keywrap requirements for private deployments. We should list KMS/HSM integration notes in the pre-read.

benji: Action items before the sync: 1) vendors fill preflight form, 2) infra publish tentative canary plan + telemetry budget, 3) SI upload integration checklist template, 4) press collect embargo day numbers per vendor.

vendor_reminder_bot: Preflight link: https://forms.redwood.example/preflight-2025-hw (will ping vendors again 10h).

tara: If you can't attend 8:30am PT, DM me. We'll run a brief 1:1 with your vendor after. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :mag_right:
